scope: vanilla simulator revisions 1, 3, and 4 (no engagement-time patch)

fourSC_support_aware_lag.reference_definition: Mean operational fourSC_lag1 coefficient among the 25 vanilla participants with at least 3 observed adjacent-slot FourSC pairs.

activity_carryover_calibration.transition_scope: same calendar day AM FourSC to PM prior-2-hour steps only
activity_carryover_calibration.window_overlap_note: AM FourSC covers wake+1h to wake+5h; PM prior-2-hour steps cover wake+4h to wake+6h, so the windows overlap for one hour.
activity_carryover_calibration.estimation_note: Pooled within-participant residual correlation after both fitted conditional means were removed. coupling_rho is that correlation rounded to two decimals. Overnight PM-to-next-AM is left uncoupled.

interaction_pageview_calibration.estimation_note: Slot-specific coefficients are delivered-slot offset-logistic maximum-likelihood estimates. The fixed offset is the script-4 page-view occurrence logit (no week_norm in PV/FW/PJ/J); the extra predictor is observed interaction minus the fitted interaction probability. No study-time engagement calibration is applied.

covariates.month: protocol month m = ceil(week/4), covariate month_c = m - 2. Weeks 1-4, 5-8, and 9-12 are months 1, 2, and 3. A 36-week episode uses months 1-9 on this same scale, with no cap. Week 0 (a Sunday starter's first day) is month 1. Month enters model 1 only.
covariates.act7: fraction of the previous 7 days active; days before study day 1 count as active; the observed week-0 Sunday is used as history; unobserved days are skipped
covariates.prior_gap: 1 on and after the day a completed gap ends (activity resumes); else 0
covariates.activity: page view, wear, or a daily end-of-day or weekly check-in submission on the participant's local calendar day

frailty.note: Experimental and unused. gamma is bimodal. Model 1 adds u_p to the logit; model 2 subtracts gamma * u_p from log theta. Fixed effects and gamma are posterior means. u_by_uid holds 1000 thinned posterior draws per modelled user. An episode draws one index from SeedSequence([seed, uid, 771337]) and then continues that stream for the path. The default activity_process_mode is 'pooled', which uses the model1 and model2 blocks.
frailty.priors: coefficients N(0, 5^2); log mu N(log 5, 1); log alpha N(0, 1); tau HalfNormal(1); gamma N(0, 1)
frailty.sampler: NUTS, 4 chains, tune 5000, draws 30000, target_accept 0.99, dense mass matrix, started at the pooled MLE. u on the gap rows is residualized on the intercept and prior_gap while sampling; c0 and c1 are mapped back to log theta = c0 + c1*prior_gap - gamma*u.

validation_2000.note: 2000 episode paths. Modelled users cycle; the seed increases after each full pass. Frailty draws u from the activity stream. Tests recompute this table.
